scope.beginning: The episode begins after the Titans have been defeated and the victorious brothers must order the cosmos.
scope.ending: It ends when Zeus receives the sky, Poseidon the sea, and Hades the underworld.

narrative.synopsis: After victory over the Titans, Zeus and his brothers divide the universe into great realms. Zeus’ claim to the sky establishes his visible sovereignty without erasing Poseidon or Hades.
narrative.openingSituation: The old rulers have fallen, but the new order needs boundaries.
narrative.centralConflict: The brothers must divide power without beginning another succession war.
narrative.resolution: Lots or agreement assign sky, sea, and underworld.
narrative.outcome: Zeus becomes sky-ruler while his brothers govern their own realms.

events.consequence: Cosmic authority is apportioned among them.
